name: A Season of War
text: Rally. (After this card is revealed in a province, add the top card of your dynasty deck to the province, faceup.) Action: Discard each card in each province, refilling each province faceup. End the dynasty phase. Then there is an additional dynasty phase, during which players do not collect fate.

name: Acclaimed Geisha House
text: Action: During a conflict, dishonor a (friendly) participating character and choose an unclaimed ring - switch the contested ring with the chosen ring. (The conflict retains its type.)

name: Alibi Artist
text: Action: If you have 6 or fewer honor – look at the top 2 cards of your conflict deck. Put 1 of those cards into your hand and the other on the bottom of your conflict deck.

versions.flavor: "No, noble Kitsuki-sama. I was having tea with the daimyō’s son at that time."

name: Assassination
text: Conflict Action: Lose 3 honor. Choose a character with printed cost 2 or lower – discard that character. (Max 1 per round.)

versions.flavor: Steel whispered through silk and flesh. In the morning, they would find the body and speak of shadows and dishonor — but tonight, the deed was done.

name: Banzai!
text: Action: During a conflict, choose a participating character – that character gets +2[conflict-military] until the end of the conflict. You may lose 1 honor to resolve this ability twice. (Max 1 per conflict.)

name: Bayushi Kachiko
text: Action: While this character is participating in a [conflict-political] conflict, choose a participating character with lower [conflict-political] than this character – move the chosen character home. Then, you may bow it.

versions.flavor: "Which of us would bid this game to end? We are nearly perfectly matched, but there can be only one victor."

name: Bayushi Kachiko
text: During [conflict-political] conflicts in which this character is participating, you may play each event in your opponent's discard pile as if it were in your hand. After you play a card in this way, remove if from the game. You cannot play more than 3 cards per round this way.

name: Bayushi Manipulator
text: Reaction: After honor dials are revealed – increase the value of your bid by 1.

versions.flavor: "Victory does not always go to the strongest of two opponents." - Bayushi's Lies

name: Beautiful Entertainer
text: Rally. (After this card is revealed in a province, add the top card of your dynasty deck to the province, faceup.) Interrupt: When this character leaves play, if you are less honorable than an opponent - gain 2 honor.

name: Blackmail Artist
text: Reaction: After this character wins a [conflict-political] conflict – take 1 honor from your opponent.

versions.flavor: "The real art lies in convincing your mark that you are bound, by duty and honor, to expose him. At which point, buying you off becomes his idea."

name: Calling in Favors
text: Action: Dishonor a (friendly) character. Choose an opponent's attachment – take control of that attachment and attach it to that character, if able. Otherwise, discard the attachment.

versions.flavor: “A secret kept is a debt forever unpaid, Kakita-sama.”

name: Censure
text: Play only if you have the Imperial Favor. Interrupt: When the effects of an event would initiate – cancel those effects.

versions.flavor: "I bring word from the Imperial Chancellor."

name: Court Games
text: [conflict-political] Conflict Action: Select one - either choose and honor a participating character you control, or your opponent chooses and dishonors a participating character they control. (Max 1 per conflict.)

versions.flavor: “We play today, so we can meet and play tomorrow.”

name: Court Mask
text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Return this attachment to your hand and dishonor attached character.

name: Court Novice
text: This character gets +2[conflict-political] while you have claimed the [element-air] or [element-water] ring.

versions.flavor: "Each detail you reveal is another tool your opponent will use against you." – Sensei Nagori

name: Cursecatcher
text: Seeker role only. Interrupt: When the effects of a province's triggered ability would initiate, if that province has any facedown cards in it - cancel those effects.

versions.flavor: "If you leave now, I cannot protect you."

name: Dispatch to Nowhere
text: Action: Choose a character with no fate - discard that character.

versions.flavor: "Your loyalty has been recognized, and you may take up your new assignment in Kinbō Province at once." – Soshi Shiori

name: Duty
text: Limit 1 per deck. Interrupt: When the effect of a card ability, ring effect, or framework step would cause you to lose your last honor – cancel that effect, then gain 1 honor.

versions.flavor: "I will be your villain, Hantei." - Bayushi

name: Elegant Tessen
text: Restricted. (No more than two restricted attachments per character.) Reaction: After this attachments enters play, if it is on a character with printed cost 2 or less - ready attached character.

name: Entrenched Position
text: This province gets +5 strength during [conflict-military] conflicts.

versions.flavor: "It would take an entire Moto horde to break through here."
“These earthworks could withstand an entire Matsu legion.”

name: For Shame!
text: Conflict Action: If you control a participating Courtier character, choose a participating character controlled by your opponent. Your opponent must select one – dishonor the chosen character or bow it.

name: Forgery
text: Interrupt: When the effects of an event would initiate, if you are less honorable than the player initiating those effects – cancel those effects.

versions.flavor: "Who could refuse an order from the most honorable Elemental Masters?" - Shosuro Hametsu

name: Honor's Reward
text: Action: During a conflict at an [element-fire] province, choose a participating character - that character gets +3 glory until the end of the conflict.

name: I Can Swim
text: Conflict Action: If the bid on your honor dial is higher than an opponent's, choose a dishonored character on their side – discard that character.

versions.flavor: "But scorpion! Now we will both die!"
“If I should sting you, why would we not both drown?”

name: Imperial Storehouse
text: Action: Sacrifice this holding – draw 1 card.

name: Kyūden Bayushi
text: Action: Bow this stronghold and choose a dishonored character you control – ready that character. If you have 6 or fewer honor, that character gets +1[conflict-military] and +1[conflict-political] until the end of the phase.

name: Loyal Challenger
text: After this character wins a conflict, gain 1 honor. After this character loses a conflict, lose 1 honor. Action: During a conflict, initiate a [conflict-political] duel - resolve the duel. Treat the printed text box of the duel's loser as if it were blank (except for Traits) until the end of the conflict.

name: Make an Opening
text: Action: During a conflict in which you control a participating character, choose a participating character controlled by your opponent – that character gets –X[conflict-military] and –X[conflict-political] until the end of the conflict, where X is the difference between the bid on your honor dial and that of your opponent.

name: Regal Bearing
text: Action: During a [conflict-political] conflict in which you control a participating Courtier character - set the bid on your honor dial to 1 and draw cards equal to the difference between your honor bid and that of your opponent. (Max 1 per conflict.)

name: Secret Cache
text: Reaction: After a conflict is declared against this province – search the top 5 cards of your conflict deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle.

name: Seeker of Earth
text: You may replace 1 province of any element with an additional [element-earth] province while deckbuilding. Reaction: After an [element-earth] province you control is revealed – gain 1 fate.

name: Shadow Stalker
text: Rally. (After this card is revealed in a province, add the top card of your dynasty deck to the province, faceup.) While you have 6 or fewer honor, this character gets +2[conflict-military] and +2[conflict-political].

name: Shameful Display
text: Action: During a conflict at this province, choose 2 participating characters – honor one of those characters and dishonor the other.

name: Shosuro Sadako
text: While this character is dishonored, add its glory to its [conflict-military] and [conflict-political] instead of substracting it.

name: Slovenly Scavenger
text: Reaction: After this character wins a conflict, sacrifice it. Choose a discard pile – shuffle that discard pile into its owner's corresponding deck.

versions.flavor: "No wonder they're always so weak and scrawny." - Hiruma Izumi

name: Social Puppeteer
text: Composure - This character must be chosen as a target of an opponent's event, if able. (You have composure if your honor bid is lower than an opponent's.) Action: During a conflict in which this character is participating - switch honor dials with your opponent until your next honor bid.

name: Upholding Authority
text: This province gets +2 strength while you have an Earth role. Interrupt: When this province is broken – the attacking player reveals his or her hand. Choose a card in their hand and discard any number of copies of that card from their hand.

name: Way of the Scorpion
text: Action: During a conflict, choose a participating non-[clan-scorpion] character – dishonor that character.

versions.flavor: To combat the liars, the thieves, and the traitors within the Great Clans, Bayushi's followers would have to lie, steal, and cheat in turn.

name: Yogo Asami
text: Bayushi Kachiko cannot be chosen as the target of abilities triggered by an opponent. Action: During a conflict in which this character is participating, bow it and choose a participating character – That character gets -2[conflict-military] until the end of the conflict.
